title: Benchmarking Debiasing Methods for LLM-based Parameter Estimates

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the misestimation of downstream population parameters (specifically, logistic regression coefficients) caused by systematic errors in LLM-generated annotations. The paper measures this bias using standardized Root Mean Squared Error (sRMSE) and standardized bias, comparing debiased estimates against an expert-annotated reference model.
